svg.aria-label: S17 The store queue, entry by entry
svg.text: S17 The store queue, entry by entry
A template whose slots the player fills. Each entry has an address half and a data half. Loads search it, and the dependence predictor beside it decides who waits.
of store and load PC pairs
addr comes from the address uop, data from the data uop.
ready means both halves are there, so it can forward or commit.
Empty rows mean nothing else is in flight.
a miss fetches the line for ownership
stores wait and drain by a threshold
or the register file, by base register
all bytes from one store, data ready
store bytes, the rest from the L1D
no data yet, or a line crossed
28 cycles when a line is crossed
for its store, by the table pair
a wrong pass costs the ordering flush
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
